planets.name: K2-165 d
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-165 with a 14.1-day year, found in 2018.

text.card: K2-165 d was found in 2018 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around K2-165. Its orbit and size follow Mayo et al. 2018's fit, the archive's default.
